observations.behavior: Adds a new Rust crate and its configuration, including CPU and optional memory profiling, and integrates it into the ingestion consumer. The ingestion consumer now starts profiling agents and keeps them alive; if memory profiling fails, it logs an error and continues. CPU profiling is always started if enabled.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support PostHog's own profiling infrastructure if PostHog adopts this Rust agent, but the chunk does not show PostHog-specific configuration, deployment, or benefit. No score assigned.
